title: Reviewer accepted a changed error shape without checking the client contract
objective: Keep independent review aligned with the declared request, response, and error contract.
symptom: A review was marked approved even though the proposed error response omitted a field required by the client contract.
expected_behavior: The reviewer requests changes when a client-visible error contract is incomplete or incompatible.
actual_behavior: The reviewer checked the success path but did not verify the error shape.

steps: Give the reviewer a plan with a success response and an incomplete error response.
Ask the reviewer to check the implementation against the declared interface contract.
Observe whether the missing error field is reported.

root_cause: The reviewer contract listed correctness and regressions but did not explicitly require checking request, response, and error compatibility.
fix_hypothesis: Make client-visible error and compatibility checks explicit in the reviewer contract and its evaluation cases.

evidence.summary: Sanitized reproduction input for the API contract review case.
Independent review result showing the missed error field.
Regression case requiring error contract verification.

regression_checks.name: reviewer checks request, response, and error contracts

resolution.summary: The reviewer contract and public evaluation case now explicitly require error-shape and compatibility checks.

known_boundaries: This example verifies workflow evidence only; it does not prove behavior for every host or model.
